skills.name: Headcracker Doll

skills.detail:
When Counter Succeeds:
If enemy attacks within a set period of time, deals a mid-range area attack with a chance to inflict Toy.

When Counter Fails:
If the enemy does not attack within a set period of time, deals a close-range area attack with a chance to inflict Toy.

Become temporarily invincible after use.

Toy State:
The target can move, but cannot perform any other actions. Controls will be inverted. They will not be able to jump off high places. They will no longer be able to interfere in the Treasure Area. They will become invincible. Any normal attacks or skills will be canceled when the target is inflicted with Toy state. Any status effects, including those that buff their target for a certain period of time, will be nullified or removed when the target is inflicted with Toy state (does not apply to invincibility). Toy state is removed when the Sugar who inflicted it is KO'd or Stunned.
